coder_notes: The only antitumour intervention is a cell therapy (EGFR BATs), so there is no candidate; EGFR expression is mechanistically linked to the BATs but they are not a candidate, hence candidate_matched false. Both arms are registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR but differ only in LIFU timing (no true control). tumour_pk_planned coded yes on the basis of PET uptake of labelled cells in tumour regions (not a drug concentration assay). Microbubbles are named in the summary (Lumason in exclusions) and are not a registered intervention; moiety inferred from the Lumason name. RT/TMZ is mentioned in outcomes ('after RT/TMZ') but not registered, so not listed.
